purpose: bounded synthetic data usefulness ablation; not a B-completion result

source.safe_definition: retained_candidate_mask & static_found & view_projection_feasible & finite signed-contact features

simulator_assumptions.response: signed centroid = [intercept, pose, lateral, depth, pose*lateral] coefficients + subject session zero-offset + Gaussian noise
simulator_assumptions.fit: least squares on detected uncensored values with per-training-subject offset columns; misses/censored values are not imputed
simulator_assumptions.heldout: sites with site_index mod 5 == 0, checked 19-degree pose knot, and two subjects are excluded from selection/fitting
simulator_assumptions.within_site_target: pose contrast at same site; session offset cancels
